name: Kukke Subramanya Temple Annadana
signature_dish: Free pilgrim meal on plantain leaf
why_it_matters: The free annadana (anna prasada) run by the Kukke Sri Subrahmanya Devasthana — thousands of pure-vegetarian meals served daily to every visitor regardless of caste, creed or religion, in the temple's airy dining hall near the entrance. A generations-old service funded entirely by devotee donations and the temple trust.
insider_tip: Lunch is roughly 11.30am-2pm and dinner about 7.30-9.30pm, with timings extended on festival days when crowds swell. The meal is simple — rice, dal, sambar, a sweet — served on a plantain leaf; come at the start of a session for a calmer queue. No charge, no payment.
signature_address: Annadana Hall, Kukke Sri Subramanya Temple, Subramanya, Sullia Taluk, Dakshina Kannada District, Karnataka 574238

name: Neo Mysore Cafe
area: Car Street, near main temple, Subramanya
signature_dish: Masala dosa and South Indian tiffin
why_it_matters: One of the two main sit-down pure-veg restaurants on Car Street by the temple — the reliable paid option for pilgrims who want a meal outside the annadana queue or breakfast before darshan. A standard Udupi-style dosa-idli-meals menu; no alcohol or non-veg anywhere in this temple town.
insider_tip: Busy right through the morning darshan rush — go early or after 10am for the calmer batch. The masala dosa and the South Indian meals are the dependable orders. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Neo Mysore Cafe, Car Street, near main temple, Subramanya, Dakshina Kannada District, Karnataka 574238

name: Hotel Kumara Kripa
signature_dish: Pure-veg North and South Indian meals
why_it_matters: The other main Car Street veg restaurant beside Neo Mysore Cafe — the go-to for pilgrims wanting North Indian options in a town where every kitchen is strictly pure-veg. A useful counterpart to the dosa-and-meals houses.
insider_tip: If you want a North Indian thali or paneer dishes rather than South Indian tiffin, this is the Car Street pick. Same temple-town rules apply — no onion-garlic fasting menus on certain days, no alcohol. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Hotel Kumara Kripa, Car Street, Subramanya, Dakshina Kannada District, Karnataka 574238

name: Thirumala Hotel
why_it_matters: A family-run pure-veg eatery on the way in as you enter Kukke Subramanya — reviewers single it out for Tulu-Nadu coastal dishes like khali dosa with gasi (a coconut-based curry) and good neer dosa, food that goes beyond the standard pilgrim tiffin menu.
insider_tip: Order the khali dosa with gasi — it is the local Tulu speciality and the reason to come here rather than a generic darshini. Quieter than the Car Street rush. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Thirumala Hotel, main road, Subramanya, Dakshina Kannada District, Karnataka 574238

name: Kukke Devasthana Bhojanashala
why_it_matters: The temple trust's own paid canteen (Bhojanashala / Sannidhi Canteen) within the Kukke Subramanya complex — a low-cost pure-veg option for pilgrims who want a fresh plate meal or South Indian breakfast without joining the free annadana queue.
insider_tip: Useful between annadana sessions or for an early breakfast before darshan — meals run around ₹50-100. Run by the Devasthana, so consistent and hygienic. No alcohol, no non-veg. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Devasthana Bhojanashala, Kukke Sri Subramanya Temple, Subramanya, Dakshina Kannada District, Karnataka 574238
